answer: Copper Depletion Ledger. Each new identity draws from a shared per-epoch quota of a token called copper; normal agents replenish slowly, but burst registration drains it, and the ledger raises the per-identity price along a convex spiral as the quota depletes. Attackers pay exponentially rising copper prices plus a refundable vault deposit locked per identity for N epochs. Sybil cost scales superlinearly with batch size while honest single registrations stay near baseline.
